instructions: Use citizen-v006 as the design source but retain citizen-v005 as the current best-so-far comparison. In v6, the main Body mesh remained on the shared fabric material, so the intended citizen-specific texture was limited to smaller panels and the cap. The bright rear horizontal/vertical seams also made a cross resembling extra equipment. Apply a deterministic tileable warp-and-weft weave directly to the main Body mesh at a scale visible in the unchanged close render. Remove the rear shoulder cross, use a low-contrast center seam and two short side darts, and darken/thin the cap-top seam so it reads as cloth stitching. Keep the v5/v6 silhouette, raised brim, goggles, domed shoulders, dimensions, animation pivots, live role equipment, and RoomScale gameplay unchanged.

targeted_changes.fabric_texture: deterministic tileable warp-and-weft ImageTexture; local to citizen fabric
targeted_changes.cap_top_seam: thin and muted to match the cap fabric

post_processing: pack generated geometry into a native Godot PackedScene with embedded materials
preserve all candidate descendants under the scene root
import and verify dimensions before standardized production rendering
material_method: Dedicated deterministic woven fabric texture; distinct leather, iron, brass, copper, skin, and glass materials
